card.statement:
Let $M$ be a $\Z^n$-graded $\B_n^{\bar{q},(1)}$-module. Then, for all $\phi \in \widehat{\k[z_1^{\pm 1},\dots,z_n^{\pm 1}]}$, we have an equality

\[
({}^\tau M)(\phi) = M(\phi) .
\]

This is obvious since the automorphisms of the twisting system $\tau$ all act trivially on $z_1,\dots,z_n$.

It follows that the set of weights of ${}^\tau M$ coincides with the set of weights of $M$.
card.label: Remark 71

paper.title: \titre
paper.abstract: We develop a general framework for studying relative weight representations for certain pairs consisting of an associative algebra and a commutative subalgebra. Using these tools we describe projective and simple weight modules for quantum Weyl algebras for generic values of deformation parameters. We consider two quantum versions: one by Maltsiniotis and the other one by Akhavizadegan and Jordan.

macros.titre: Weight modules of quantized Weyl algebras
